name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(at_exit) satisfies the requirement 'Go to the exit'. The hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) correctly implements 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' by requiring a toggle (switch_toggled) at or after every start of siren_ringing. The machine has no redundant clauses and correctly handles the conditions (e.g., allowing success only if at_exit is reached with siren silent via the path through u1->u2).

texts: Whenever siren rings, toggle switch to turn it off
